open.reason: The frozen source state carries allowance remaining and spent per party and asset, and four of the lifecycle ensures assert post allowance values. The compiled contract's public surface has no allowance field and the nine-field kernel state has no allowance slot. How allowance remaining and spent are represented on the ledger, or why they may be omitted, is stated nowhere.

The source state has four used-identifier registers (transfer, allocation, origination, accrual). The ledger has only revision and the kernel cursor f7. A replayed accrue with a fresh revision and an eligible cursor has no on-ledger identifier register to reject it, and the design's replay-history requirement has no compiled counterpart.

No document maps the lifecycle obligation fields (principal, accrued, outstanding, initialPrincipal, nominalLiabilityCap, liabilityIncurred, lastAccruedPeriod, nextAccrualAt) onto the ledger kernel fields f0..f8. Without it, 5.1a has no defined lowering for outstanding principal and interest. The same gap covers the asset and unit mapping: the selected source case is Cash at quantum 1 while the existing ledger fixture is USD_TEST_ASSET denominated USD_micro, and no document states the scale that carries source amounts onto ledger units.

netGoalRule.statement: A net goal passes exactly when checked(credits) >= checked(debits + minimumLedgerAmount).
summation: credits sum Transfer and Fee effects with to == A for that asset
debits sum Transfer and Fee effects with from == A for that asset
a self-transfer contributes to both sums
DueCreated and DueSettled contribute to neither, avoiding double-counting settlement records
a missing debit or credit sum is zero

items.reason: The frozen source state carries allowance remaining and spent per party and asset, and four of the lifecycle ensures assert post allowance values. The compiled contract's public surface has no allowance field and the nine-field kernel state has no allowance slot. How allowance remaining and spent are represented on the ledger, or why they may be omitted, is stated nowhere.

The source state has four used-identifier registers (transfer, allocation, origination, accrual). The ledger has only revision and the kernel cursor f7. A replayed accrue with a fresh revision and an eligible cursor has no on-ledger identifier register to reject it, and the design's replay-history requirement has no compiled counterpart.

No document maps the lifecycle obligation fields (principal, accrued, outstanding, initialPrincipal, nominalLiabilityCap, liabilityIncurred, lastAccruedPeriod, nextAccrualAt) onto the ledger kernel fields f0..f8. Without it, 5.1a has no defined lowering for outstanding principal and interest. The same gap covers the asset and unit mapping: the selected source case is Cash at quantum 1 while the existing ledger fixture is USD_TEST_ASSET denominated USD_micro, and no document states the scale that carries source amounts onto ledger units.

The frozen initial state contains a third party Other holding asset Token with allowance remaining 3 and spent 1. The compiled loan binds exactly one asset domain (usdDomain) and two roles. Whether Other and Token survive lowering, or are dropped as source-only, is undecided.
